Name: StardewOptimizer
Author: dcbnmkdshjbnfas
Description:
[size=4][b]DescriptiA modular performance optimization framework for Stardew Valley 1.6+.

Unlike most optimization mods that ship as one big switch, this gives you 14 independent modules — each with its own toggle, compatibility checks, and live stats. All risky optimizations are off by default.

**What makes it different:**
- Modules coordinate through a central hub. High memory pressure pauses preloads, doubles NPC throttling, stops particle culling. Hard GC makes everything yield.
- Adaptive CPU budget caps optimization work at 25% of frame time.
- Auto-disables on known conflicts (UI Info Suite 2, Better Crafting, Lookup Anything, etc.)
- 9 console commands for deep diagnostics.

**Highlights:**
- 14 modules covering menus, NPCs, monsters, crops, particles, memory, Automate, and more
- All risky features off by default — you opt in
- Graceful fallback everywhere; nothing crashes the game
- Modular by design: enable only what you need

**Requirements:** Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+

**Optional:** Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game settings; Automate for the two Automate modules.on[/b][/size]
